20.en: "There is nothing so dangerous as misplaced faith. Save your prayers for the God-Emperor!"

38.en: The @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.HURMpEU0Nnc93Ocv]{Adeptus Ministorum} is slowly corrupting and hampering the growth of the Imperium.

46.en: The God-Emperor does not need the Ministorum to reach those who embrace His Power.

54.en: For Mankind to be free, the Imperial Cult must be removed from power.

76.en: The Ministorum is such a hulking organisation that it must be infiltrated and dismantled from within. Monitor and subvert its activities throughout the sector, particularly on shrine worlds. Manage the Imperial Cult’s contact with frontier and reclaimed worlds, where its influence can be easily undermined.

82.en: These Radical Inquisitors believe that the Adeptus Ministorum is failing in its role to lead the masses in their worship of the God-Emperor. Only their devotion to the God-Emperor prevents them from being branded heretics, even as they deny the Ministorum’s power and campaign to abolish the Ministorum.

86.en: As the Macharian Sector is a major pilgrimage destination for Imperial citizens, the Seculos Attendous have made their presence here known. These Inquisitors do not approve of the worship of Lord Solar Macharius over the God-Emperor, and their agents have made loud announcements on days of mass worship, reminding attendees of His supremacy. Others send their agents to shrine worlds to quietly undermine the influence of the Adeptus Ministorum. There are even rumours of a secret cult growing among the Imperial worlds of the Macharian Sector that worship under the guidance of Inquisitors, and this is likely the work of the Seculos Attendous.

90.en: The Seculus Attendous disapprove of @UUID[.0vHms9BJQGOVa0dO]{Thorians}, @UUID[.zilJJMaYtaWZrNtO]{Horusians}, and those of similar philosophies, but seek to convert rather than destroy them. In turn, they are unpopular with the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.HURMpEU0Nnc93Ocv]{Adeptus Ministorum}, and @UUID[.R7LueEsDUhrSYHNn]{Amalathians} object strongly to their operations.

106.en: A Seculos Attendous Inquisitor is often wholly focused on their secret war with the Adeptus Ministorum — they might care little for more ‘regular’ heresies that arise that do not involve the Ministorum in any way.

114.en: The Ministorum is an organisation that ultimately dwarfs the Inquisitors' powers. They must maintain a meticulous cover, perhaps presenting themself as a follower of another philosophy. They know that retribution from their peers within the Inquisition and the Ministorum would be swift if they were to be discovered. 0

122.en: A Seculos Attendous Inquisitor will keep their friends close, and their enemies closer — whatever they can do to ingrain themselves with the Ministorum will help further their goals.

136.en: An undercover agent on Lux Eternus has contacted the Seculos Attendous Patron, requesting immediate extraction. Their attempt to foster a rebellious cult on the hive world has come to light. The Patron may have left them to die if they were not the Planetary Governor’s liaison with the Ministorum, Cardinal Mirrad Vorn — people might believe them if they invoked the Inquisitor’s name.

144.en: The Ministorum is attempting to re-indoctrinate wayward cults on the reclaimed world of Olympia. A mix of false and conflicting doctrine is causing conflict between the cults, and the Ministorum is failing to wrest control. Now is the perfect opportunity to infiltrate both the cults and the Ministorum, solve the crisis and install some deep cover agents for future use.
